notes: SNES PLAYER_NAME commands are represented explicitly as Android-style %S(index,0) placeholders for comparison only.

Very-high-confidence SNES-to-Android-English identity is not rejected merely because French wording is freely adapted.
When French or Android segmentation crosses individual anchors, preserve and review the complete local sequence block rather than forcing a per-ID translation.

scenes.label: Gold City - Light Palace / tower key NPC

units.source_display:
King Manmon sealed off the
Light Palace, at the edge
of town.
units.android_english_display: King Mammon sealed off the Light Palace at the edge of town.
units.french_display: Seul le roi peut entrer dans la tour à l'extérieur de la ville. On l'appelait jadis "Temple de la Lumière".
units.note: Three-line NPC speech begins an exact ordered run.

units.source_display:
The tower key was stolen by
a spy from Tasnica. Caught
him in Southtown.
units.android_english_display: The tower key was stolen by a spy from Tasnica. Caught him in Southtown.
units.french_display: Un espion de Tasmanica en a volé la clef il y a des années, mais il a été capturé à Méridia et exécuté.
units.note: Second entry of the same ordered NPC run.

units.source_display: But the key was never found!What's in that tower?
units.android_english_display: But the key was never found! What's in that tower?
units.french_display: On n'a cependant jamais retrouvé la clef... Je me demande bien ce qu'il y a dans cette tour.
units.note: Third entry of the same ordered NPC run.

units.source_display:
LUKA:Undine, the Elemental
 of water, lives in a cave
 behind a waterfall.
 It's east of the steps
 leading to this palace.
 You've got to find her!
 Her seal on this palace
 has failed, and I fear
 she is in great danger!
units.android_english_display: Luka: Undine, the elemental of water, lives in a cave behind a waterfall. It's east of the steps leading to this palace. You've got to find her! Her seal on this palace has failed, and I fear she is in great danger!
units.french_display: Rusalka : Ondine, l'esprit de l'eau, vit dans une caverne derrière la cascade à l'est de ce temple. Le sceau qu'elle avait placé sur ce temple s'est soudain rompu. Je m'inquiète pour elle. Suis le chemin à l'est et va la voir !
units.note: English aligns 1:1 in order, but French redistributes the same scene content across the three slots; validate as a block, not per ID.
